bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDtb has two native issuance routes—Ethereum Anchorage USDtb and the Solana Token-2022 mint 8yXrtJ54jZtE84xEBzTESKuegjcAkAuDrdAhRd8i8n3T (mint/permanent-delegate C2QJ4HKLWzWRNprAmKoyd6YqXouVHFZuLKujdqtF4ZDt)—and LayerZero OFT representations on Ethereum (adapter over the native inner token), Arbitrum, and Base. The EVM OFT owner is a 5-of-10 Safe. DefiLlama and official key-addresses treat only the Token-2022 mint as Solana circulating; a separate LayerZero Solana OFT mint 39DrizvVVntnUhKkyy7Nu8v1YDySA1y4R1uBnv4U7zYy exists with ~3.24 tokens and is omitted from the catalog so the Solana supply row matches exactly one native route.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; mint-bridge-boundary migration

routes.reviewNote: USDtb is native on Ethereum (Anchorage attestation identifies Ethereum and Solana as native deployments; MINTER_BURNER_ROLE mint reviewed in the mint-authority profile).

At Arbitrum block 495303139 on 2026-08-16, the verified USDtbOFT burns USDtb on send and mints only on validated LayerZero receive; owner/delegate is the 5-of-10 Safe 0xe897d8620d5eba2c8ecaaf0ada191a23230ab8ec, not a native issuer. EndpointV2 is 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, so this is a bridge representation rather than independent native issuance.

At Base block 50067660 on 2026-08-16, the verified USDtbOFT burns USDtb on send and mints only on validated LayerZero receive; owner/delegate is the 5-of-10 Safe 0xe897d8620d5eba2c8ecaaf0ada191a23230ab8ec, not a native issuer. EndpointV2 is 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, so this is a bridge representation rather than independent native issuance.

USDtb is native on Solana. Official key-addresses and DefiLlama chainConfig.solana.issued list only Token-2022 mint 8yXrtJ54jZtE84xEBzTESKuegjcAkAuDrdAhRd8i8n3T. At finalized slot 440112810 on 2026-08-18, getTokenSupply was 45,928,759.21 (6 decimals), matching DefiLlama currentChainBalances.Solana. Mint and permanent-delegate authority C2QJ4HKLWzWRNprAmKoyd6YqXouVHFZuLKujdqtF4ZDt is a system-owned wallet (Mint Authority sidecar). A separate LayerZero OFT mint 39DrizvVVntnUhKkyy7Nu8v1YDySA1y4R1uBnv4U7zYy (3.242001 tokens) is not this circulating row.

controls.label: USDtb Ethereum LayerZero OFT adapter owner Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero metadata identifies this deployment as an OFT_ADAPTER whose innerTokenAddress is native USDtb 0xc139190f447e929f090edeb554d95abb8b18ac1c; the adapter locks the inner token on outbound transfers and releases it on validated inbound messages.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Ethereum block 25771071 on 2026-08-16, isPeer(30110, 0xc708b6887db46005da033501f8aebee72d191a5d) and isPeer(30184, 0xc708b6887db46005da033501f8aebee72d191a5d) returned true on the adapter; the owner Safe can change peer configuration. LayerZero Scan (queried 2026-08-18) also shows delivered ETH/Arb/Base ↔ Solana messages whose Solana OApp is OFT Store HFss3BXK8SLaWvskdgA9L2YHKxVH1WKfpxmQFukNypVt (EID 30168), 2-of-2 required DVNs LayerZero Labs + Nethermind, ULN V302. That Solana OFT mint is catalog-omitted because its live supply is 3.242001.
routeChecks.rateLimits: rateLimiter() = address(0); the verified source exposes owner-controlled rate-limit configuration, so no active aggregate or per-call rate limiter was observed.
routeChecks.caps: The adapter's bridge accounting is lock/unlock over the native inner token; no independent native-issuance cap is claimed for this route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The owner Safe controls peer, delegate, enforced-options, message-inspector, and rate-limit configuration. Safe guard/fallback reads were unavailable through the tested ABI; enabled-module pagination returned an empty list.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero Scan's latest returned Arbitrum-to-Ethereum message record (2026-05-26) showed required DVNs Horizen, LayerZero Labs, Canary, and Nethermind, 20 confirmations, ULN V302, and Executor 0x31cae3b7fb82d847621859fb1585353c5720660d. This historical record is not a fresh current getConfig read for every direction and is due for refresh.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771071 on 2026-08-16, the canonical-side LayerZero OFT adapter was owned by Safe 0xe897d8620d5eba2c8ecaaf0ada191a23230ab8ec, whose current threshold is 5 of 10 signers and whose enabled-module pagination returned an empty list. The adapter locks native USDtb for outbound transfers and releases it on validated inbound messages; its owner controls peer, delegate, enforced-options, message-inspector, and rate-limit configuration. Guard/fallback status remains unverified.
